newsitem.title: USA: KODAK NAMES NEW UNIT PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: KODAK NAMES NEW UNIT PRESIDENT.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said Thursday that Robert Unterberger, president of of its digital and applied imaging business, has resigned.
The company named Willy Shih, currently chief operating officer and vice president of digital and applied imaging, as the new president of the unit.
The company said Unterberger resigned to "pursue other interests."
Unterberger joined Kodak in March 1996 from International Business Machines Corp, where he was general manager of interactive broadband services.

Shih joined Kodak in July, with responsibility for hardware and software product development in capture, storage, and integrated solutions. Previously, he was vice president of marketing for technical computing at Silicon Graphics Computer Systems.
